bio: 11 Cadogan Gardens is a boutique luxury hotel in the heart of Chelsea. The redbrick Victorian façade comprises four separate town houses, combined to create a cosy and sumptuous environment in which to enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea.  Partake in this British tradition in the comfort of the hotel's Drawing Room, nestled around the open fire or in The Secret Garden, during the warmer months.  The Chelsea Garden Afternoon Tea pays tribute to their privileged location on Cadogan Gardens, as well as the fact they are surrounded by some of the most beautiful gardens in London. Each menu item is designed to evoke the flavours and aromas of the garden, and create a memorable experience that transports guests to a state of relaxation and escape, as if they were taking a stroll through a beautiful park on a warm summer’s day.  Gluten Free, Vegan, Nut free options are available on request. Please give 48 hours notice in order for the hotel to accommodate your request.  11 Cadogan Gardens is close to London’s most aspirational shopping districts, with Harvey Nichols and Harrods just a short walk away.
